These PDFs come from the hayro test suite (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro,
`hayro-tests/pdfs/custom`), licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

`forms_ko.pdf` is AUDENIQ's own test document, written by `make_forms_ko.py`
(`python3 make_forms_ko.py forms_ko.pdf`): Korean text in fonts that are not
embedded, standard and non-embedded Latin fonts, and form fields with and
without appearance streams under `/NeedAppearances true`.
